M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation

In this first portion of this module, you have considered some of the paradoxes that define global energy development, gained a basic primer on trends in energy access, renewables and efficiency, and studied how energy is linked to other development priorities, such as education, health, food, and jobs, often powering the systems that enable these sectors to function.
However, energy trends manifest differently depending on local context.

This chapter will focus on energy in UNDP’s five regional bureaus, focusing specifically on regional contexts, challenges, opportunities, and strategies to achieving SDG 7 (access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all).
